description: This file defines the Comment class responsible for writing cell comment annotations into an ODS spreadsheet using XML. It interacts with Cell and XMLWriter classes, retrieving comment data from a worksheet and serializing it into an XML structure for OpenDocument format.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: A class providing static method to write cell comments as XML elements in the ODS format.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the comment associated with a cell to XML, including dimensions, position, author, and text.
